verses.2: And she again bare his brother
verses.3: And in process of time it came to pass, that
verses.7: If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door. And unto thee shall be his desire, and thou shalt rule over him.
verses.10: And he said, What hast thou done? the voice of thy brother's blood crieth unto me from the ground.
verses.11: And now art thou cursed from the earth, which hath opened her mouth to receive thy brother's blood from thy hand;
verses.12: When thou tillest the ground, it shall not henceforth yield unto thee her strength; a fugitive and a vagabond shalt thou be in the earth.
verses.14: Behold, thou hast driven me out this day from the face of the earth; and from thy face shall I be hid; and I shall be a fugitive and a vagabond in the earth; and it shall come to pass, that every one that findeth me shall slay me.
verses.15: And the LORD said unto him, Therefore whosoever slayeth
